findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md (Backend 6): a test that needs a Spring context is an integration test: it extends `IntegrationTest`... Exception: a test that boots the `demo` profile...
findings.note: Three nested @SpringBootTest contexts (:72, :87, :104) not extending IntegrationTest; not demo-profile. Cause: IntegrationTest's @DynamicPropertySource pins app.carrier-invoice-retention.enabled=false, which inline properties cannot override. Fix the test (e.g. a hook on IntegrationTest) or get a written carve-out.
The two 410 tests (:1000, :1014) repeat setup and assertion, differ only in storage availability; one parameterised test.
Identical carrierInvoiceFileDeleted handler also at ClientInvoiceByIdController.java:172; follows the per-controller pattern rule 7 prescribes; debt at most.
New JSDoc paragraph spliced mid-sentence ('...The Attach' / bare blank line / new text / 'The Attach control itself...'). Rejoin.

findings.citation: DESIGN.md Paused files section: "the notice appears only when something is really paused (the attach control, or a file not deleted)"
findings.note: When the notice shows only because Attach is offered and every file is deleted (an Agent's sent-back draft during an outage, story 18), the copy at 55-59 still says "Attaching and downloading are paused" (or "Attaching, removing and downloading..."); nothing is downloadable. The wording should follow the same count line 44 uses: name downloading only when a file is not deleted. Untested narrow case.
